description: Decide a rock-paper-scissors round from player a's perspective: return draw on a tie, win when a's move beats b's per the beats table, and lose otherwise; reject any move outside rock, paper, scissors. Pure and deterministic; the floor uses flat guard clauses and a single beats lookup (an excessively-nested rewrite would replace the flat checks with deep if/elif ladders per move). The golden arg_sets cover the value-returning domain: all three winning matchups, all three losing matchups, and all three draws. The invalid-move ValueError (bad first move and bad second move) is exercised by the pytest gate in test_suite.py, since the golden recorder captures return values, not exceptions.
